newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pakhoed says Q1 profit up considerably.
newsitem.headline: Pakhoed says Q1 profit up considerably.

text.p: Dutch tank storage and shipping group Pakhoed NV said on Tuesday its net profit had shown strong growth in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the year-ago period.
"Contrary to 1996, the year 1997 has started in an excellent way," the company said in a statement.

Pakhoed said business in the current year confirmed its previous expectation that 1997 net profits attributable to ordinary shareholders would be significantly higher than 1996's 138.3 million guilders.
In March, the company said it expected double-digit profit growth in 1997.

Pakhoed said its U.S. chemical distribution activities showed a further improvement in the first quarter. The oil storage unit in Rotterdam, which was reorganised recently, made a positive contribution to profits. Shipping and chemicals storage maintained their favourable trends, it said.
